Body.Content:
Learning Agent proactively delivers personalized AI and Copilot upskilling notifications through Microsoft Teams, helping users discover relevant learning opportunities in their flow of work. These notifications are tailored to users' roles, Copilot adoption stages, and usage patterns, guiding them toward practical scenarios and skills they can apply in everyday tasks.

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: November CY2026
